name: What kind of compensation can I expect after a big-rig accident?

mainEntity.name: What kind of compensation can I expect after a big-rig accident?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compensation in a big-rig accident can cover various damages, including medical expenses (past and future), lost wages due to injury, pain and suffering, and property damage to your vehicle. In some cases, if the at-fault party's conduct was particularly egregious, punitive damages may also be awarded. The specific amount depends on the severity of your injuries, the impact on your life, and the specifics of the accident. An attorney can help evaluate your losses and pursue appropriate compensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: You may receive compensation for medical bills, lost wages, pain and suffering, and property damage. An attorney can help assess your specific losses.
